steps.description:
Let's summarise what you have learnt so far.


These are the input sensors and output modules that you have learnt.

     


You've explored how Lists and Functions have taken your code to another level. Now, design a meaningful project that uses them, whether it’s a game or a task-based application. You do not need to use all the different blocks but should try to use more to demonstrate your knowledge.

The project must be logical and purposeful, as you'll later document it in presentation slides. 

Use at least two of the following coding concepts:

  • Variable
  • List
  • Function

Use at least one of the following input sensors:

  • Colour Sensor
  • Ultrasonic Sensor
  • 1 to 3 Buttons

Use at least one of the following output modules:

  • Buzzer
  • LCD
  • Motor

You should NOT 

  • simply copying or lightly modifying existing snippets.
  • use blocks that have not been taught.
  • exceed 500 in total blocks. You can right-click on white space in your coding area to see the count.

You will be guided in using AI to support your creative journey. Let your instructor to walk you through the process.

Link to AI notes

Having great ideas is certainly not easy, but you did it before! You can revisit your snippets from past works or look at images for inspiration.

  

Best project of the month rewards you with 40 coins!
